phrases.def: 工作工作组工作组工作组工作组工作组
助理主管主管主管助理主管

sentences.en: There is clear-cut evidence that, for a period of at least one year, supervision which increases the direct pressure for productivity can achieve significant increases in production.
sentences.zh: 有明确证据表明,至少一年的时间里,增加生产力直接压力的监督可以实现产量的大幅增长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: However, such short-term increases are obtained only at a substantial and serious cost to the organisation.
sentences.zh: 然而,这种短期增长只能以给本组织带来巨大和严重代价为代价。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: To what extent can a manager make an impressive earnings record over a short period of one to three years by exploiting the company’s investment in the human organisation in his plant or division?
sentences.zh: 经理人在多大程度上能够利用公司在其工厂或部门对人力组织的投资,在短短的一至三年时间内取得令人印象深刻的收入记录?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: To what extent will the quality of his organisation suffer if he does so?
sentences.zh: 如果他这样做,他的组织的质量将受到多大的损害?

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The following is a description of an important study conducted by the Institute for Social Research designed to answer these questions.
sentences.zh: 以下是社会研究所为回答这些问题进行的一项重要研究的说明。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The study covered 500 clerical employees in four parallel divisions.
sentences.zh: 这项研究涉及四个平行部门的500名办事员。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Each division was organised in exactly the same way, used the same technology, did exactly the same kind of work, and had employees of comparable aptitudes.
sentences.zh: 每个部门都以完全相同的方式组织,使用同样的技术,从事完全相同的工作,并且有具有类似能力的雇员。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Productivity in all four of the divisions depended on the number of clerks involved.
sentences.zh: 所有四个司的生产力都取决于所涉办事员人数。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The work entailed the processing of accounts and generating of invoices.
sentences.zh: 这项工作涉及处理帐目和出具发票。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Although the volume of work was considerable, the nature of the business was such that it could only be processed as it came along.
sentences.zh: 虽然工作量很大,但业务的性质决定了只能随着业务的出现进行处理。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Consequently, the only way in which productivity could be increased was to change the size of the workgroup.
sentences.zh: 因此,提高生产力的唯一办法是改变工作组的规模。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The four divisions were assigned to two experimental programmes on a random basis.
sentences.zh: 四个司被随机分配到两个实验方案。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Each programme was assigned at random a division that had been historically high in productivity and a division that had been below average in productivity.
sentences.zh: 每个方案都随机指定一个司,该司的生产率历来很高,一个司的生产率低于平均生产率。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: No attempt was made to place a division in the programme that would best fit its habitual methods of supervision used by the manager, assistant managers, supervisors and assistant supervisors.
sentences.zh: 方案没有试图在方案中设立一个最适合管理人员、助理管理人员、主管和助理主管使用的惯常监督方法的司。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The experiment at the clerical level lasted for one year.
sentences.zh: 文书一级的实验持续了一年。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Beforehand, several months were devoted to planning, and there was also a training period of approximately six months.
sentences.zh: 前面说,几个月用于规划,还有大约六个月的培训时间。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Productivity was measured continuously and computed weekly throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 整个一年中,生产力的计量是连续不断的,并每周计算。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The attitudes of employees and supervisory staff towards their work were measured just before and after the period.
sentences.zh: 雇员和监管人员对其工作的态度在这一期间前后都进行了衡量。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Turning now to the heart of the study, in two divisions an attempt was made to change the supervision so that the decision levels were pushed down and detailed supervision of the workers reduced.
sentences.zh: 现在谈谈研究的核心,在两个部门,有人试图改变监督,以便降低决策级别,减少对工人的详细监督。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: More general supervision of the clerks and their supervisors was introduced.
sentences.zh: 开始对办事员及其主管进行更普遍的监督。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In addition, the managers, assistant managers, supervisors and assistant supervisors of these two divisions were trained in group methods of leadership, which they endeavoured to use as much as their sill would permit during the experimental year.
sentences.zh: 此外,这两个司的管理人员、助理管理人员、主管和助理主管接受了集体领导方法的培训,他们努力在试验年尽量使用集体领导方法。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: For easy reference, the experimental changes in these two divisions will be labelled the ‘participative programme!
sentences.zh: 简而言之,这两个司的实验性变化将称为“参与方案!

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In the other two divisions, by contrast, the programme called for modifying the supervision so as to increase the closeness of supervision and move the decision levels upwards.
sentences.zh: 相比之下,在另外两个司,方案要求修改监督,以提高监督的密切程度,并将决策级别提高。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This will be labelled the ‘hierarchically controlled programme’.
sentences.zh: 将称为 " 等级控制方案 " 。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: These changes were accomplished by a further extension of the scientific management approach.
sentences.zh: 这些变化是通过进一步推广科学管理办法实现的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: For example, one of the major changes made was to have the jobs timed and to have standard times computed.
sentences.zh: 例如,所作的一项重大改变是,定时工作并计算标准时间。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This showed that these divisions were overstaffed by about 30%.
sentences.zh: 这表明这些司的工作人员过多,约占30%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The general manager then ordered the managers of these two divisions to cut staff by 25%.
sentences.zh: 总经理随后命令这两个司的管理人员削减25%的工作人员。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This was done by transfers without replacing the persons who left; no one was to be dismissed.
sentences.zh: 这样做的方式是转移,而没有取代离开的人;没有人可以被解雇。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Changes in productivity Figure 1 shows the changes in salary costs per unit of work, which reflect the change in productivity that occurred in the divisions.
sentences.zh: 图1显示每个工作单位薪金费用的变化,反映了各司的生产力变化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: As will be observed, the hierarchically controlled programmes increased productivity by about 25%.
sentences.zh: 如下文所述,按等级控制的方案使生产率提高了约25%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This was a result of the direct orders from the general manager to reduce staff by that amount.
sentences.zh: 这是总经理直接命令减少工作人员这一数额的结果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Direct pressure produced a substantial increase in production.
sentences.zh: 直接压力导致生产大幅度增加。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A significant increase in productivity of 20% was also achieved in the participative programme, but this was not as great an increase as in the hierarchically controlled programme.
sentences.zh: 参与方案也大幅度提高了20%的生产率,但并没有像等级控制方案那样大幅度提高。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: To bring about this improvement, the clerks themselves participated in the decision to reduce the size of the work group.
sentences.zh: 为了实现这一改进,办事员本人也参与了关于缩小工作组规模的决定。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: (They were aware of course that productivity increases were sought by management in conducting these experiments.)
sentences.zh: (当然他们知道管理层在进行这些试验时要求提高生产力。 )

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Obviously, deciding to reduce the size of a work group by eliminating some of its members is probably one of the most difficult decisions for a work group to make.
sentences.zh: 显然,决定通过取消工作组的一些成员而缩小工作组的规模,可能是工作组作出的最困难的决定之一。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Yet the clerks made it.
sentences.zh: 然而,书记员还是做到了

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In fact, one division in the participative programme increased its productivity by about the same amount as each of the two divisions in the hierarchically controlled programme.
sentences.zh: 事实上,参与方案的一个司提高了生产率,其数额与等级控制方案的两个司的每个司大致相同。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The other participative division, which historically had been the poorest of all the divisions, did not do so well and increased productivity by only 15%.
sentences.zh: 历史上在所有各司中,其他参与司都是最贫穷的,但情况并不理想,生产率仅提高了15%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Changes in attitude Although both programmes had similar effects on productivity, they had significantly different results in other respects.
sentences.zh: 虽然这两个方案对生产力的影响相似,但在其他方面却有显著不同的结果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The productivity increases in the hierarchically controlled programme were accompanied by shifts in an adverse direction in such factors as loyalty, attitudes, interest, and involvement in the work.
sentences.zh: 等级控制方案的生产力提高的同时,忠诚、态度、兴趣和参与工作等因素也出现了不利方向的转变。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: But just the opposite was true in the participative programme.
sentences.zh: 但参与方案的情况正好相反。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For example, Figure 2 shows that when more general supervision and increased participation were provided, the employees’ feeling of responsibility to see that the work got done increased.
sentences.zh: 例如,图2显示,如果提供更普遍的监督和增加参与,雇员对确保完成这项工作的责任感就会增加。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Again, when the supervisor was away, they kept on working.
sentences.zh: 主管不在的时候他们又继续工作

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In the hierarchically controlled programme, however, the feeling of responsibility decreased, and when the supervisor was absent, work tended to stop.
sentences.zh: 然而,在等级控制的方案中,责任感下降,当主管不在时,工作往往停止。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: As Figure 3 shows, the employees in the participative programme at the end of the year felt that their manager and assistant manager were ‘closer to them’ than at the beginning of the year.
sentences.zh: 如图3所示,年底参与方案的雇员认为他们的经理和助理经理 " 更接近他们 ",而不是年初。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The opposite was true in the hierarchical programme.
sentences.zh: 等级方案的情况正好相反。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Moreover, as Figure 4 shows, employees in the participative programme felt that their supervisors were more likely to ‘pull’ for them, or for the company and them, and not be solely interested in the company, while in the hierarchically controlled programme, the opposite trend occurred.
sentences.zh: 此外,如图4所示,参与方案的雇员认为他们的主管更可能对他们或公司和他们 " 拉拉 ",而不只是对公司感兴趣,而在等级控制的方案中,出现相反的趋势。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。
